root_cause.statement: Each affected observer requested OperationQueue.main delivery. NotificationCenter therefore made a background post wait for the main queue to invoke the observer, even though the observer immediately performed a separate Task transfer to MainActor. When MainActor synchronously waited for maintenance, the publisher and test formed a cycle.
